name: Laila Illoway
prior_offices: Sublette County assessor (listed on the official assessor page; she was re-elected in 2026)
background: Laila Illoway is the Sublette County assessor and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official assessor page lists her in that office and describes the statutory duty to locate, identify, and value taxable real and business personal property in the county as of January 1 of each year under Wyoming Department of Revenue guidelines.
